Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack | PS5 Games
https://www.playstation.com/games/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4/

Forged in Valor.

The Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack for Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 was created in close collaboration with Medal of Honor recipient and U.S. Marine Corps veteran Kyle Carpenter.

Inspired by Kyle's act of valor and recovery journey, the pack brings elements of his story into the game through authentic details drawn from his military service, personal mantras, and experiences.

Every purchase makes a difference. 100% of Activision's net proceeds from the C.O.D.E. Valor Pack will be donated to the Call of Duty Endowment. Available now at www.callofduty.com/valor #CODEValor

Firefighting Simulator: Ignite - Year 1 Recap Trailer | PS5 Games
https://store.playstation.com/product/EP2430-PPSA17456_00-0206793519245545

What a year! 🚒🔥 Celebrate Year 1 of Firefighting Simulator: Ignite on PlayStation 5 and look back at an action-packed year filled with new missions, vehicles, equipment, and exciting challenges.

From the Summer Camp and Parker’s Story DLCs to the Kenworth® Fire Truck Pack and the Motor Vehicle Accident Expansion, Year 1 brought plenty of new ways to answer the call. Alongside the Year 1 Season Pass content, free updates introduced new missions, Alarm Mode, the Shannondale district, and more.

🚒 All Year 1 content is now available on PlayStation 5.

UNITED AGAINST FIRE.

https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UB2551-PPSA38507_00-0568047176185872

Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest is the first console game based on the best-selling book series by Erin Hunter. Create your own Warrior Cat, join a Clan and forge bonds with allies, and rise through the ranks as you hunt prey, patrol territories, uncover secrets, and defend your home in strategic turn-based combat. Every journey is shaped by your choices, relationships, and the prophecy guiding your destiny.

https://www.playstation.com/games/cyberpunk-2077/?country-selector=true

Seen the anime? Play the update — if you’re ready…

Dive back into Night City with the free Edgerunners 2 Update for Cyberpunk 2077, featuring content inspired by Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. Take on a new quest that takes place before the anime’s raw, brutal story begins; carry on Jackie’s legacy with the Dual Wielding playstyle; and discover much more as you pick up the pieces in the City of (Broken) Dreams.

The Edgerunners 2 Update is out now on PlayStation 5.
